regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Pembrolizumab — It helps immune cells recognise cancer. The immune system can also inflame healthy organs. Paclitaxel — It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected. Carboplatin — It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Pembrolizumab, paclitaxel and carboplatin on day 1 every three weeks for 6–8 cycles, according to benefit and tolerability. Pembrolizumab alone every three weeks while it helps and side effects are manageable.
key_points: Combination every 3 weeks, then pembrolizumab alone.

Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount. Bevacizumab — It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: After surgery, the first cycle contains paclitaxel and carboplatin. Bevacizumab starts from cycle 2 if the wound has healed and the team considers it safe. Paclitaxel, carboplatin AUC 6 and bevacizumab 15 mg/kg on day 1 every three weeks. Chemotherapy is given for up to six cycles. Bevacizumab alone every three weeks, up to 15 months (22 cycles) across treatment, or until progression or unacceptable side effects.
key_points: Up to 6 combination cycles, then bevacizumab alone.

regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: First platinum-sensitive recurrence of epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer after no previous VEGF-directed treatment.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Bevacizumab — It reduces signals that help tumours form blood vessels. This can also affect blood pressure, kidneys and wound healing. Gemcitabine — It interferes with copying DNA as cells divide. Blood-forming cells can also be affected. Carboplatin — It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Bevacizumab, gemcitabine and carboplatin on day 1 of each three-week cycle. Six cycles are usual and up to ten may be given. Gemcitabine alone after a blood count and kidney check. If omitted for low counts, this dose is skipped for the rest of the cycle. After chemotherapy finishes, bevacizumab alone every three weeks while it helps and side effects are manageable.
key_points: Days 1 and 8 every 3 weeks, then bevacizumab alone.
